candidate_workaround: Credit neither the timed-out wrapper nor its partial output as a passing witness; split candidate search from status inspection.
failure_signature: A combined exact-title diagnostic and full status listing exceeded its bounded wrapper after emitting the collision title and seed-file status.
recurrence_guard: Do not append a broad status traversal to a diagnostic whose primary answer is already available.
rollback: Give the failed attempt no proof credit, retain it, and rely only on a bounded passing witness.
scope_boundary: Bounded same-owner recovery only; no independent reproduction, production, professional, scientific, legal, cultural, or authority credit.
title: Recover diagnostic wrapper timeout without erasing its failed witness
trigger_preconditions: A bounded v650-v6 workflow exposes diagnostic wrapper timeout.
